newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Norilsk Nickel may strike May 15 - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Russian Norilsk Nickel may strike May 15 - Tass.

text.p: Workers at the flagship plant of Russia's Norilsk Nickel metals group may strike on March 15, Itar-Tass news agency quoted Boris Degtyaryov, deputy head of the plant's United Trade Union committee, as saying Wednesday.

It quoted him as saying that the committee had decided to suggest the strike proposal date at a meeting set for March 1 between labour and management and that if a strike were to occur, about 50,000 workers would take part.
He did not say how long output disruptions could last but was quoted as saying management had rejected workers' proposals to pay off salary arrears.
"We understand they cannot pay off 900 billion roubles all at once," Degtyaryov was quoted as saying.

"For this reason, we suggested that they send some money to pay off housing payments and vacation packages for employees and children of the plant. In the end of ends, they could give us some shares in exchange for salary arrears.
"But management did not accept a single one of these constructive options. Instead, they established a (salary arrears) repayment schedule that we consider an insult to workers."
